text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wood, fire, earth, metal, and water—the
five
elements.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
From firewood to fire, to a meal of the
earth's
bounty. By maintaining that chain
before you run,
you'll improve both
physically and mentally!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Repetition of basic cycles like these is a
part of
feng shui. I'm gonna stick to it
every day until
summer training camp is
over!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey trains diligently every
single day.
As for whether it paid off...
choice_data_list: さらに加速だ、リッキー！
さらに加速だよ、リッキー！

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainerrr, I'm exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's worn to the bone, but it's clear just
by
looking at her how much she's
leveled up her
game.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You've really impressed me, Rickey. I
always
thought you were the more
out-there, mysterious
type...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
But now I know you're a harder worker
than
anybody. It's like I had you all
wrong.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A hard worker? You really think so? All I
do is try
and figure out the right path,
then charge straight
down it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I just wanna make everyone
happy. And
Trainer teaches me how to
improve so I can do
just that. ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yep! Falco's support really helped!
choice_data_list: お疲れ様。よくついてきたな
お疲れ様。よくついてきたね
choice_data_list_en: Good work. You followed along well.
Good work. You followed along well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's covered in dirt and sand from head
to toe.
It's proof that she gave
everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Hokko Tarumae could see Copano
Rickey now,
maybe it would rekindle her
spirit...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...It's so frustrating, not being able to
encourage
Tarumae directly.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I could send her a picture, but I think
it'd just
make her feel worse, and I don't
want to push her
away even more. She's
got higher standards for
herself than
anyone.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Not even feng shui can help us here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The qi vein connecting Copano Rickey
and
Hokko Tarumae remains weak. All
we can do is
entrust the matter to fate.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I think it might be time for a certain
Umadol
to shine!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I might be able to help out where
feng shui
can't.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Say, Rickey? How about we make a
video to
commemorate the end of
summer camp? ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: A video? Sure.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆ Super-special
training! We
finally made it through our
tough summer camp
training schedule!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
With Falco's help, I pushed myself to my
limits
and got some amazing results! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's all to make my dream come true—my
dream
to use the power of feng shui to
make everyone
happy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So I'm never gonna back down! As long
as there
are people out there who only I
can bring a smile
to, I've gotta keep
moving forward! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That's all from Copano Rickey! ♪ Thanks
to
everyone on Falco's UmaTok for
watching!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Was that okay, Falco?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yep, that was perfect. ☆ Well, I think
that's
about all the help I can give you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The rest is up to Tarumae.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't be surprised if she was still
watching
Umadol and local idol videos.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We just have to believe in her and be
patient. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's all to make my dream come true—my
dream
to use the power of feng shui to
make everyone
happy.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So I'm never gonna back down! As long
as there
are people out there who only I
can bring a smile
to, I've gotta keep
moving forward! ☆
Sniff... Sob!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Smart Falcon's efforts, a crack
has
been opened up in Hokko Tarumae's
armor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All we can do now is believe that fall will
bring a
tailwind that will help her find
her bearings—and
push both her and
Copano Rickey to greater
heights.
